subject: Post-call: Trial plan, success metrics, and request to add chat summarization
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Lucas Chen <lucas@shoploop.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-18T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed trial plan (next steps)

Hi Lucas — thanks for the productive call earlier. Quick recap and the proposed next steps so we have the same view going into the trial: 

Summary of scope
- Primary: product search reranking (homepage & category) using Redwood embeddings + reranker
- Optional: query intent routing for long-tail queries (low traffic)

Success criteria (proposed)
- Reranker: +8% CTR on promoted slots or +0.06 NDCG uplift on click-lift test window
- Latency: 95th percentile token latency under 150ms per request for live traffic
- Stability: <0.5% error rate over 48h smoke test

Evaluation plan & timeline
- Week 0 (this week): data handoff, schema review, set up dev endpoints (owner: Marcus)
- Week 1–2: offline evals + initial tuning on holdout set (owner: Marcus)
- Week 3: deploy canary for 10% traffic; collect metrics (owner: Monica)
- Week 4: full traffic ramp decisions / final acceptance (owner: Monica)

Ownership
- Technical lead: Marcus Lin (redwood)
- CS / success contact: Monica Patel (redwood)
- Sponsor / buyer: Lucas Chen (ShopLoop)

Open items / asks for you
1) Confirm data delivery timeline for product feed + click logs (we will need sample logs by EOW)
2) Confirm whether you want the optional intent routing included in the initial trial or staged after reranker evaluation
3) Any additional internal stake holders who should be looped in (security, infra)?

Attached: proposed-poc-plan.pdf — includes acceptance matrix and proposed test queries.

Next step: if you confirm data timing and the optional use case choice, Marcus will send the ingest checklist and we’ll schedule the dev endpoint handoff.

Thanks again — excited to get started.

—
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0192

From: Lucas Chen <lucas@shoploop.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya@retailco.com>
Date: 2027-04-19T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed trial plan (next steps)

Thanks Irene — appreciate the clear recap. A few asks / changes from our side after internal sync: 

1) Add a second use case to the trial: chat summarization in the customer support console. The summarization model will be used to produce a short answer + action items for agents. This is higher priority for our CX team than intent routing.

2) Slightly adjust success criteria: for the chat summarization use case we want >= 85% of summaries rated as "useful" by a 100-sample QA set (we can provide raters) OR a 10% reduction in average handle time in the pilot.

3) Timeline: the CX team would like the pilot to start one week earlier if possible — can we compress the dev handoff to 3 business days instead of one week? We understand this is tight; please confirm feasibility.

4) Data: we can deliver a redacted sample of support transcripts (sample-logs.zip attached) and a nightly export of product feed. Security team will review once we share the agreed ingest checklist.

Open questions for Redwood: can the same model variant be used for both reranking and summarization? If not, what's the estimated additional cost / time to onboard a second model?

– Lucas
Lucas Chen
Head of Product, ShopLoop (GoodCart Group)
lucas@shoploop.com
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>

Key changes he asked for: add chat summarization as a second use case (prioritize over intent routing), updated acceptance metric (>=85% useful by QA set or 10% AHT reduction), and compress handoff to 3 business days if feasible. Also attached the sample logs he dropped in.

Action items I propose: 
- Marcus: confirm if we can support same model variant for both reranking & summarization (quick feasibility check + rough cost delta). If not feasible, provide an estimate for onboarding a second model and time to ingest the transcripts.
- Rishi: please advise on any security/compliance blockers for ingesting the redacted support transcripts and the expected time for a fast-track review.
- Monica: if timeline is compressed, please outline an adjusted acceptance gate / rollback plan for a 3-business-day dev handoff + 1-week canary.
